verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's API reference documents a first-party endpoint to merge two persons, so the product itself offers contact merging. Nothing in the evidence covers duplicate detection, merging organizations (companies), or how data is kept during a merge. missing for 10: duplicate detection, organization/company merge, documentation of data preservation during merge, UI-level merge flow for ops users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can detect duplicate contacts or companies and merge them without losing data
